newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks hit new all-time high.
newsitem.headline: French stocks hit new all-time high.

text.p: French stocks hit an all-time high in mid-morning trading on Wednesday, with the blue-chip CAC-40 share index touching 3,007.84, up around three percent. The index's previous historic high was 3,006.54.
Traders had predicted new highs as stock and bond markets rallied on Wednesday in the wake of comments by U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan that U.S. inflation was modest.
Banking stocks jumped in a second day of renewed speculation on sector restructuring, with BNP and CCF up more than nine percent and other bank stocks also surging.
The franc hit its lowest this year against a soaring dollar, at 6.1720 against the U.S. unit.
